name: delegation
description: Delegate bounded Codex work across trusted peers with synchronized Git workspaces.

interface.shortDescription: Delegate Codex work across trusted peers
interface.longDescription: Discover equal peers, synchronize an explicit Git HEAD plus dirty state, dispatch isolated managed Codex workers, collaborate through messages and lifecycle controls, and inspect target-retained changes-artifact metadata. Worker changes are never applied to the root workspace automatically.
defaultPrompt: Delegate a bounded repository task to the best available peer.
Synchronize this Git workspace and run platform-specific validation on another peer.
Wait for the managed worker and summarize its changes artifact without applying it.
